name: habitat-bunny
description: The Habitat night, inside Codex. Grill the idea, park scope creep, refuse localhost, roast what shipped.

interface.shortDescription: Lock, build, ship, roast. One evening.
interface.longDescription: Your agent writes the code. The bunny keeps the clock honest: it grills the idea, parks scope creep, and will not call it shipped until a stranger can click a URL. Local skills plus a local MCP gate. No account. Nothing leaves your machine.
